provenance: Project-authored synthetic notes and context annotations. No real patient records are included. Independent clinical adjudication is not documented.
entity_annotation_coverage: Partial positive/context examples; not exhaustive over all target mentions or all note text.
split_method: No train/validation/test split. The rule-based pipeline has no fitted model; the complete bundled synthetic corpus is used only for descriptive development evaluation.
leakage_note: No held-out performance estimate is claimed. Patient-group splitting is required before any future model fitting or holdout evaluation.
limitations: The annotation set is small and not independently reviewed.
Entity annotations are not exhaustive, so extraction precision and F1 cannot be computed.
Temporal and longitudinal metrics are unavailable because corresponding gold labels are absent.
Synthetic results do not establish clinical validity.
